name: salon-elite-site
description: Static marketing site for Salon Elite, Mayfield KY.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:format && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:site
scripts.build:pages: python3 _source/genpages.py && prettier --write privacy.html terms.html 404.html && html-validate privacy.html terms.html 404.html
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run lint:a11y && npm run build
